script_text: Taurus, Saturn just squared your Sun and everything you thought was stable is about to be tested big time. Monday through Wednesday, Venus your ruling planet sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House, flooding your finances with unexpected opportunities, but beware Mercury opposite your Mars on Tuesday — arguments over money will drain your earth energy fast. The turning point arrives Thursday when the Moon enters your 7th House, smothering relationships in need-to-have conversations you have been avoiding for weeks, and honestly Taurus, your partner or crush finally gets what they deserve because Venus trines Pluto in your 5th House this weekend sparking deep passionate romantic breakthroughs that change everything. Late week lightens up beautifully as the Sun trines your natal Venus Sunday, gifting you warmth, creative joy, and the financial confidence you deserve. Your power day is Thursday because the 7th House Moon forces honesty that sets you free. Your worst day is Tuesday because Mercury opposite Mars breeds costly misunderstandings. This week, anchor yourself in emerald green energy and say yes to every financial opportunity that crosses your path. Follow for daily updates.
